label: CER eCTD 4.0 — Clinical Evaluation Plan
description: Clinical Evaluation Plan (CEP) for VenaGuard™ IVC Filter (Class III, EU MDR).

inputs.device_name: VenaGuard™ Retrievable Inferior Vena Cava (IVC) Filter
inputs.device_classification: Class III (Rule 8, EU MDR 2017/745 — implantable device)
inputs.intended_purpose: Temporary or permanent prevention of pulmonary embolism (PE) in patients with deep vein thrombosis (DVT) who have contraindications to anticoagulation therapy or who have failed anticoagulation therapy
inputs.cep_scope: This Clinical Evaluation Plan covers the systematic assessment of clinical data for the VenaGuard™ IVC Filter, including literature review, analysis of clinical investigations, and post-market data, to demonstrate compliance with EU MDR General Safety and Performance Requirements (Annex I). The CEP defines the clinical evaluation strategy, acceptance criteria, and integration with post-market surveillance activities.
inputs.device_description: The VenaGuard™ is a conical nitinol retrievable IVC filter deployed via femoral or jugular vein access under fluoroscopic guidance. It features 12 struts with atraumatic hooks for caval wall fixation, a retrieval hook at the apex, and a low-profile 7F delivery system. The filter is intended for both temporary (retrievable within 180 days) and permanent implantation.
inputs.subj_clinical: PE prevention in patients with DVT contraindicated to anticoagulation
inputs.equiv_clinical: Same — PE prevention in patients with DVT
inputs.subj_technical: Nitinol conical filter, 12 struts, 7F delivery, retrievable
inputs.equiv_technical: Nitinol conical filter, 12 struts, 8F delivery, retrievable (Bard G2 Express)
inputs.search_databases: PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane Library, WHO ICTRP, clinicaltrials.gov
inputs.search_terms: IVC filter, vena cava filter, pulmonary embolism prevention, retrievable filter, anticoagulation contraindication, nitinol filter, filter migration, filter thrombosis
inputs.search_inclusion: Clinical studies (any design) reporting safety/performance outcomes for conical nitinol IVC filters; sample size ≥20; English, German, or French
inputs.search_exclusion: Non-clinical studies, case reports with <5 patients, letters/editorials, pediatric-only populations, non-retrievable filters
inputs.appraisal_method: Modified Oxford Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine (OCEBM) levels 1–5; GRADE certainty assessment for key outcomes
inputs.clinical_investigation_plan: A prospective, multicenter, single-arm clinical investigation (VG-EU-001, N=150) is ongoing per ISO 14155:2020. Primary endpoint: technical success rate of filter placement and retrieval. Secondary endpoints: PE recurrence rate at 6 months, filter-related complications (migration, fracture, IVC penetration, thrombosis) at 12 months.
inputs.pms_integration: Clinical evaluation will integrate data from: (1) PMCF study VG-EU-001, (2) complaint/vigilance database (SAE, FSCA, trend reports), (3) literature surveillance (annual update), (4) EUDAMED registry data, and (5) equivalent device literature.
inputs.cep_update_schedule: The CEP will be reviewed and updated: (1) annually as part of the PMS/PSUR cycle, (2) upon completion of VG-EU-001 PMCF study, (3) whenever new safety signals are identified, (4) at each CER revision. Minimum update interval: 12 months per EU MDR Article 61(11) for Class III devices.
